perks.name: Power of the Son
perks.description: Being in combat for a duration grants progressively more flinch resistance and damage resistance versus combatants.
perks.exact:
While maintaining a state of dealing or receiving damage every 7 seconds:
Grants a stack of Power of the Son after 12 seconds, up to 2 stacks after 24 seconds.

Power of the Son x1 | 15% Damage Resist against Combatants and ?% Flinch Resist.
Power of the Son x2 | 25% Damage Resist against Combatants and ?% Flinch Resist.
